description: check every construction file in a project folder for structural errors — a product nothing uses, a fragment consumed twice, a step that runs before its input exists
phrases: did anyone make a mistake in the cloning plan
find errors in an experiment plan
check a project folder before ordering primers
does the assembly use the right fragments
returns: one line per file — ok with a step count, or the findings with their reasoning. Exit 1 when anything was found, so it drops into a hook or CI unchanged
notes: Takes a directory or a single file; add --json for machine output. Every check was written against a defect found in a real repository on 2026-09-10 rather than an imagined one: a Gibson consuming the same fragment twice while its sibling was abandoned, in the file a whole plasmid lineage rests on. Reports rather than repairs — a construction file is somebody's experimental record, and a plausible automatic fix is how a wrong number becomes permanent. Files written in the pre-publication style are named as LEGACY_FORMAT at warn level and not checked, because guessing at their structure is worse than saying so.
